annotations.title: Find the cheapest stores for a shopping list

description: Where to buy several products together in Polish stores for the least money, delivery included (each store's delivery prices and free-delivery thresholds): the cheapest split across stores, and the best options with one store or at most two. Pass the products' ids from search_products, with quantities; any_version lets a model's other colours or versions count.

any_version.description: Any colour or version of the same model will do.

name: plan_shopping_list
